anomalies.description: A person wearing a yellow vest is on the ground, being struck and pulled by multiple police officers in riot gear; the individual appears helpless and non-resisting while being physically assaulted.

Ongoing violent unrest involving multiple police officers in riot gear confronting protesters in an urban plaza; smoke, chaotic movement, and use of batons/shields indicate collective violent clash beyond peaceful protest.

Mutual physical engagement occurs between at least two individuals: one officer pulls the fallen protester while another (civilian or officer in casual attire with helmet) approaches aggressively with a baton-like object; motion blur suggests active struggle.

Ongoing violent confrontation between a group of riot police and protesters in an urban street; includes deployment of shields, batons, physical restraint, and visible smoke/haze suggesting tear gas or similar crowd-control measures; multiple individuals engaged in aggressive group actions beyond peaceful protest.

A person wearing a yellow vest is on the ground, visibly restrained and struck by multiple police officers in riot gear and by a civilian in a black jacket with 'POLICE' on the back; the victim appears helpless and does not resist while being kicked, pushed, and held down.

Ongoing violent unrest: large group of riot police in full protective gear actively engaging with protesters on a city street; smoke/tear gas visible, crowd movement suggests confrontation, and physical restraint of a protester is occurring as part of broader group conflict.

A person wearing a yellow vest is on the ground, surrounded and physically restrained by multiple police officers in riot gear; officers are seen pulling, holding, and pressing down on the individual over an extended period without apparent resistance from the person on the ground.

A person wearing a yellow vest is on the ground, surrounded by multiple riot police officers in full gear who are actively engaging with them—some holding shields over the individual, one appears to be striking or pressing down, and others are positioned to restrain. The individual is in a vulnerable, prone position and does not appear to be resisting. This constitutes abuse of a helpless victim.; A police officer in riot gear is seen striking or forcefully pushing a person lying on the ground who is wearing a yellow vest and holding a small shield; the person appears incapacitated and unable to defend themselves.

Ongoing violent unrest involving multiple riot police and civilians in a street setting: deployment of shields, use of force against individuals on the ground, presence of smoke/tear gas, and chaotic movement. The scene shows coordinated police action against protesters, including physical subduing and dispersal tactics, consistent with a riot.

Sustained violent confrontation between multiple police officers in full riot gear and protesters, including use of shields, physical force, and deployment of crowd-control measures (e.g., apparent tear gas/pepper spray visible as mist in later frames); includes a person being subdued on the ground and another being forcibly moved while visibly distressed.

In frames f12–f15, a woman in civilian clothing is being physically restrained and appears to be struck or pushed by a police officer (visible in f13–f15), while another officer assists. The woman raises her hands defensively and recoils; the interaction involves direct physical contact and resistance, indicating mutual engagement at that moment—not purely one-sided abuse—thus qualifying as fighting during this interval.

A woman in a black jacket and yellow vest is being physically restrained and pushed by two officers; she appears distressed and non-aggressive, with hands raised or open, while one officer appears to deploy a chemical agent (visible white mist near her face in f5–f7).

A police officer in riot gear appears to strike or forcefully push a woman wearing a yellow vest, who is visibly recoiling and raising her hands defensively; the interaction is aggressive and one-sided.
Multiple officers in riot gear confront a group of protesters on a street; visible use of shields and physical engagement suggests collective violent unrest beyond peaceful protest.
